info.title: SDC Form Manager
info.description: This profile defines the expected capabilities of the *SDC Form Manager* role when conforming to this implementation guide.  This role builds on the [SDC Form Fill Manager](CapabilityStatement-sdc-form-fill-manager.html) by adding the ability to create and maintain Questionnaires and their associated resources.

Full details on the process can be found [here](modular.html).
